about_the_game: Take over an abandoned car factory and bring it back to life. Clean and upgrade the facility, then assemble cars, craft parts, and grow your business. Sell vehicles and components to become an auto industry powerhouse.
detailed_description: Take over an abandoned car factory and bring it back to life. Clean and upgrade the facility, then assemble cars, craft parts, and grow your business. Sell vehicles and components to become an auto industry powerhouse.
name: Make My Car Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2.6GHz or similar
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 700 series or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 3.3GHz or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 series or similar

short_description: Restore an old factory, assemble cars and sell them, create parts and sale them to build your automotive empire from the ground up
